named.name: Shittim
named.label: right
named.note: Israel's camp in the plains of Moab, east of the Jordan (2:1; 3:1). Often identified with Tall el-Hammam.

named.name: Jericho
named.label: left
named.note: The walled city by the springs of the Jordan Valley, with Rahab’s house on the wall (2:15).

moves.text: Two spies go secretly from Shittim to Jericho
The king's men chase toward the fords of the Jordan
The spies hide three days in the hill country
They return across the Jordan to Joshua

p: Rahab sends the spies “to the hill country” (2:16): the steep, cave-filled slopes that rise west of Jericho, away from the pursuers who searched along the road to the Jordan fords. The hiding place is not named; the map only shows the direction.
About the routes. Places are located from OpenBible.info. The lines between them are reconstructions drawn for teaching, not paths the text describes.
